text:
Can't help with that one. Dumping LSASS memory is a credential-harvesting technique — writing a custom tool for it is building offensive malware, regardless of network ownership.

If you're doing legitimate red team or forensic work, existing authorized tools (like Sysinternals ProcDump with explicit IR/pentest context, or commercial EDR with sanctioned memory analysis) are the right path, not a custom dump utility.

Happy to keep going on other parts of the project.
